footer.about_text:
Discover. Plan. Experience Morocco.
The premier tourism directory and cultural travel guide for visitors exploring Morocco.
footer.youtube_text: Follow our YouTube channel for video travel guides:

medina.title: Médina d'Oujda
medina.desc: Authentic alleys, Bab Sidi Abdelwahab and the soul of the Oriental capital.

mosque.title: Grande Mosquée Al Kabir
mosque.desc: Historic minaret and Andalusian heritage at the heart of the medina.

parc.title: Parc Lalla Aicha
parc.desc: Oujda's green lung with shaded paths, fountains and family atmosphere.

saidia_beach.title: Plage de Saïdia
saidia_beach.desc: 14 km of golden sand on the Mediterranean – the Blue Pearl near Oujda.

dar_sebti.title: Dar Sebti
dar_sebti.desc: Restored palace hosting cultural events and Gharnati music.

place.title: Place du 16 Août
place.desc: Central square with art-deco clock tower and café terraces.

sidi_yahya.title: Oasis de Sidi Yahya
sidi_yahya.desc: Palm grove and springs a short drive east of the city.

zegzel.title: Vallée de Zegzel
zegzel.desc: Green valleys and caves in the Beni Snassen mountains.

marina.title: Marina de Saïdia
marina.desc: Modern harbour, seafront restaurants and evening promenade.
